metadata_support.required_scope: All original clocks, ROI mappings and qualifying presentation tables; agreement across every original plane of each of703 sessions, followed by unchanged per-plane support and exclusions

chunks.required_scope: All supported intervals and ALL source columns from each original, including explicit empty results for zero supported events

completeness.success_scope: Complete selected census stage only; a complete1936-original disposition inventory may record failed scientific metadata/support from VLEN or resource refusal.

scientific_functions.source: Exact external accepted range pipeline plus original six-module closure
scientific_functions.clock_support: Computed independently for each original plane after shared session schedule; no cross-plane event intersection

chunk_contract.physical_index_API: Maintained h5py DatasetID chunk metadata APIs; exact new use requires generated qualification
chunk_contract.contiguous: Require an addressable allocation and full source-column stride
chunk_contract.unallocated_fill: Explicit disposition with no fill-value decoding and no zero-value inference

admission.memory_numbers: Reservation estimates, not hard OS or process-tree RSS certificates
admission.global_request_body_logical_read_write_c: Required across the stage; all repeated/failed admitted work remains charged
admission.final_disposition_and_wrapper_receipt: Disjoint reserved write allowances, protected from ordinary artifacts
admission.dff_chunk_shape_and_raw_bytes: Evidence for future projection planning only; no current signal decoding or decoded-signal RAM certificate.

profiles.scope: Finite policy caps, not expected transfer, scientifically guaranteed completion or current availability

layout_structural_output_reservation.scope: Structural output reservation, not predicted transfer or a hard memory certificate

qualification.new_generated_controls: Required: exact generated worker/plan/source/runtime identities and separately retained result plus independent acceptance; no test-outcome claim in this contract.
qualification.plan_constructor_API: build_plan(core_source, wrapper_source, range_source, original_root, operation_profiles, evidence_root, worker_source) -> dict
qualification.plan_constructor_scope: Pure function: no writes/native imports/network. CLI writes fresh PLAN JSON and prints its SHA256 only; never executes the worker and never acts as scheduler.
qualification.new_runtime_qualification: Its own bounded generated-control outcome; no portable ABI or prior-runtime approval is inherited.
